title: Huge cell text xlsx 002
notes: 500 unique deterministic strings of ~200 chars each in A1:A500 — a string-volume stress for the workbook's string storage: this openpyxl build stores them inline (t="inlineStr", no sharedStrings.xml part), MS/Excel writers would use a sharedStrings table, so readers must handle both paths; all 500 lines are in the reference text, no truncation allowed.
